name: me.routestories/routes
title: Route Stories
description: Real walks, runs, rides, dog walks and city tours with GPS audio stories and music.

tools.name: find_routes
tools.description: Search Route Stories: about 2,000 real walking, running and cycling routes, dog walks and city tours (UK, United States, Italy, France, Spain), each a GPS audio tour with narrated stories and music. Search by place (town, county, state, country, area, route name or theme word) or by a lat/lng point, and filter by activity, kind and length. With no place or point, returns the featured routes. Give the person each route's url to hear and buy it. Never invent routes: if none match, say so.

lat.description: Latitude of a point to search near (with lng). Takes precedence over place.

lng.description: Longitude of a point to search near (with lat).

radius_km.description: How far from the point to look, in km (default 60).

kind.description: everyday walks, runs and rides (default), city_tour or dog_walk.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: One Route Stories route in full: description, highlights (the places its stories are about), distance, climb, time per activity, start point, parking, public transport, access, surface, dogs, nearby routes, and the url where the person hears and buys it.

id.description: The route id from find_routes, such as canterbury-city-walls.
